title: Geometric properties and flux of locally conformally symplectic diffeomorphisms
summary: We investigate the geometric and topological properties of the group of locally conformally symplectic (LCS) diffeomorphisms, utilizing the LCS flux homomorphism defined by S. Haller. By analyzing the flux map from the universal cover of the identity component $(\ker Φ)_0$ to the first Lichnerowicz cohomology group $H_ω^1(M)$, we establish a short exact sequence characterizing the Hamiltonian subgroup $\Ham_Ω(M)$ and provide conditions for its topological splitting as a semidirect product. We develop LCS analogues of fundamental symplectic results, including a Weinstein neighborhood theorem,…
